items.html: And the secret of the matter is that it was explained above that half of the Yesod of Atik is clothed within the lower half of the Tifferet of Arich Anpin, and it is literally clothed within the head of ZA; and from that Yesod of Atik came out these lights mentioned above, after they spread from above to its place, and from it came out these seven of the skull of ZA.
